family_rule: Reuse authenticated typed-ancestry family-registry-v3 exact UniProt mapping; ambiguous/unmapped accession quarantined
family_certification: Candidate typed family/source units only; no independent evolutionary-family claim
source_rule: Primary document DOI required; source IDs/provenance retained; no new external assay service
metadata_frame_ranking: Family-round-robin; within family prefer targets with more reference-type assays having >=128 distinct molecule IDs, then document diversity, then fixed hash. These are outcome-free catalog counts, not nonmissingness or potency.
assay_ranking: Up to four hash-ranked reference-capable assays per target; remaining auxiliary slots favor document/context diversity and metadata coverage with hash ties. Never truncate an admitted assay support graph.
metadata_count_scope: IDs/type/units/relation only; no numeric values or value-derived flags before candidate freeze
old_assay_rule: All fifty R0 assays remain separate exposed diagnostics, excluded from the new frame; retain their source/target exposure for role protection
protected_family_rule: Exclude known protected typed-family IDs and proteins from all new source-value qualification; do not change historical task roles
exposed_family_rule: Historical development/validation family metadata and prior document/target exposure cannot become a new untouched final unit
role_assignment: Source/family connected components; force exposed components development. Other components hash buckets 0-2 development,3-4 validation,5-9 final. Keep original task roles unchanged.
panel_sampling: After restricted support validity/protection, hash-stratify shared support to satisfy 64/32 coverage, then fill to128; never rank by activity magnitude
